Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [ə.βənˈdo.nu]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [ə.bənˈdo.no]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [a.banˈdo.no]

Verb

[edit]

abandono

  1. first-person singular present indicative of abandonar

Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Old French abandonerbor.
Esperanto abandono

    From Old French abandoner.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /abanˈdono/
    • Audio:(file)
    • Rhymes: -ono
    • Syllabification: a‧ban‧do‧no

    Noun

    [edit]

    abandono (accusative singular abandonon, plural abandonoj, accusative plural abandonojn)

    1. abandonment, relinquishment

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • abandoni (“to relinquish”)
    • abandonismo (“fear of abandonment”)

    References

    [edit]
    • André Cherpillod, “abandono”, in Konciza Etimologia Vortaro [Concise Etymological Dictionary], →ISBN
    • “abandono”, in Plena Ilustrita Vortaro de Esperanto [Complete Illustrated Dictionary of Esperanto], 2020, →ISBN
    • “abandono”, in Reta Vortaro [Online Dictionary] (in Esperanto), 1997-2026

    Anagrams

    [edit]
    • Abadonon, abonadon

    Tagalog

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Borrowed from Spanish abandono.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔabanˈdono/ [ʔɐ.bɐn̪ˈd̪oː.n̪o]
    • Audio:(file)
    • Rhymes: -ono
    • Syllabification: a‧ban‧do‧no

    Noun

    [edit]

    abandono (Baybayin spelling ᜀᜊᜈ᜔ᜇᜓᜈᜓ)

    1. abandonment
      Synonyms: kapabayaan, pagpapabaya, pag-abandona
    2. neglect; negligence
      Synonyms: kapabayaan, pagpapabaya, pag-abandona

    Related terms

    [edit]
    • abandona
    • abandonada
    • abandonado

    [edit]
